commands.label: tokenize-input
argv:
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/tools')
from strata_tokenizer import Tokenizer
p=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/share/strata-sycl/packs/qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s/tokenizer')
v=json.loads((p/'vocab.json').read_text())
t=[None]*len(v)
for text,index in v.items():
 t[index]=text
m=(p/'merges.txt').read_text().splitlines()
ty=json.loads((p/'token_type.json').read_text())
tk=Tokenizer(t,m,ty)
x=tk.encode('Explain the purpose of a linked list and give a short example.')[:8]
assert len(x)==8
print(json.dumps(x))
